subject: Esign protocol & evidence checklist for DPA/subprocessor onboarding
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Esign protocol & evidence checklist for DPA/subprocessor onboarding

Hi Sasha,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per next steps from your procurement and security teams, I'm attaching our latest redline of the DPA (redline_dpa_v3.docx) and the current subprocessor inventory (subprocessor_inventory_2026-07.csv). Quick checklist/questions so we can keep the signature path moving: 

- Preferred e-signature platform (DocuSign vs AdobeSign) — we can support either, but we need to know so we prepare the correct envelope/authorities.
- Evidence packet: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II report under NDA, a redacted pen-test summary (pen_test_summary_q2_2026.pdf), and the subprocessor CSV. Will Horizon accept the redacted pen test or do you require the full report in a secure portal?
- Audit rights language: your redline asked for expanded onsite audit rights. Our security team prefers evidence-based controls and scheduled remote audits; can you confirm whether you need physical onsite audit rights or an operational evidence review?
- Data transfer controls: our subprocessor inventory flags a managed infra provider with EU transfers. We can provide SCCs and the standard data transfer addendum if needed.

If you confirm DocuSign, we'll send the DPA envelope (redlined) for signature and include the evidence links. If AdobeSign is required, let us know and we'll repackage.

Attached: redline_dpa_v3.docx, subprocessor_inventory_2026-07.csv, pen_test_summary_q2_2026.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0191
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@horizonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SaaS Security <sec-team@horizonhealth.com>, procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Esign protocol & evidence checklist for DPA/subprocessor onboarding

Ben —

Appreciate the materials. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Signature: Procurement prefers DocuSign for certificate-of-completion and our internal workflow. Please prepare DocuSign envelopes.
2) SOC 2: We will only accept SOC 2 Type II upon completion of a mutual NDA. Our security team will also need to validate the report's scope (controls tested: CC1-CC7, infra and application). Can you confirm scope?
3) Pen test: Summary is fine initially. If we need the full report we'll request access to a secure portal (SFTP or OneDrive with EDR and restricted link). Please indicate what redactions will be applied (IPs, customer IDs).
4) Subprocessors: we need explicit confirmation of any subprocessors that store or process personal data in the EU. Please mark those in the CSV with country and whether Standard Contractual Clauses are in place.

Procurement timeline: we are aiming to complete signature and onboarding by 2026-08-12. Can your team meet that?

Thanks,
Sasha Patel
Sr. IT Procurement Manager
Horizon Health

Subject: Re: Esign protocol & evidence checklist for DPA/subprocessor onboarding

Thanks Sasha — quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) DocuSign: confirmed — we will prepare a DocuSign envelope and include the redline DPA as an attachment.
2) SOC 2 scope: SOC 2 Type II, report period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30. Scope: Security and Availability (CC1-CC7) covering hosting, inference runtime, and platform controls. We require a mutual NDA before delivering the full report; summary highlights are included in the pen_test_summary_q2_2026.pdf.
3) Pen test redactions: we redact external customer IPs and low-level network details; the summary includes findings, remediation status, and CVE references. If you require full report access, we can provision a time-limited SFTP link after executing a data access addendum.
4) Subprocessor CSV: we've flagged EU processors in the CSV and added a column for SCCs-in-place (true/false). If any are missing SCCs we can propose mitigations (data localization or alternative subprocessors).

Proposed steps to hit 2026-08-12:
- Today (08/02): I prepare DocuSign envelope and attach redline_dpa_v3.docx + subprocessor CSV + evidence summary links.
- 08/03: Horizon legal to review DocuSign envelope and confirm redline accept/requests.
- 08/04–08/05: Finalize signatures.
- 08/06–08/12: Onboarding intake and evidence handoff to your security team.

Neha (cc'd) is our security/compliance lead — she'll coordinate SOC2 access and the pen test secure transfer. Marissa will track the DocuSign envelope and commercial timeline.

Attachments: redline_dpa_v3.docx, subprocessor_inventory_2026-07.csv

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-03T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Esign protocol & evidence checklist for DPA/subprocessor onboarding

Sasha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement note: to keep our internal incentives aligned, Horizon's one-page evidence packet is perfect — it speeds things through procurement and security sign-off. Ben, can you produce a single PDF package that includes:
- DPA redline (front page with short summary of material redlines)
- SOC2 summary (one-page bullets + link to full report behind NDA)
- Pen test executive summary
- CSV exported as a short table showing any EU subprocessors and SCC status

I'll attach that PDF to the DocuSign envelope and include the HubSpot deal link so legal sees the commercial context (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4589). Our target remains signature by 08/05 if possible — that helps get the onboarding kickoff scheduled for the week of 08/09.

Marissa Cole
Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
